entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A Yawgmoth praetor who claims to decide who is worthy of their works.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian master served by praetors such as Gix.

entities.name: Rana
entities.description: A Suq'Ata market fool who asks about apes wearing golden furs.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A wizard adept who chides with 'Temper, temper.'

entities.name: Daudi
entities.description: A Femeref tutor who says he only reveals.

entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: People whose saying says medicines exist for all afflictions but idleness.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: People of Jamuraa; Daudi is a Femeref tutor.

events.summary: Gix declares that praetors decide who is worthy of their works.
events.quote: We decide who is worthy of our works.

events.summary: Rana asks whether apes wear golden furs when they marry.
events.quote: Is it true that the apes wear furs of gold when they marry?

events.summary: Ertai chides an opponent with 'Temper, temper.'
Daudi says he does not teach but simply reveals.
events.quote: I do not teach. I simply reveal.
